title: Stolen Heart
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: In a European-style costume drama, a spoiled aristocrat is kidnapped and sexually overpowered by a masked thief, and the two meet again in teasing love-hate encounters (PW, MU). Two shorter stories follow: schoolboys introducing each other to sex, and a U.S. congressman pressed to marry while secretly with his male secretary (PW, MU).
